onlineHelp.p1.title: ONLINE CO-OP
onlineHelp.p1.body:
Fight the waves together - up to {0} of you.

One of you HOSTS and runs the game.
Everyone else JOINS and fights alongside.

You share the wave counter and the boss,
but you each keep your own health and AP.

Friends can drop in after the run has begun.
onlineHelp.p2.title: SETTING IT UP
onlineHelp.p2.body:
HOST - pick HOST GAME, then send your friends
your IP address. Over the internet you must
forward TCP port {0} on your router first.

JOIN - pick JOIN GAME, type the host's IP,
then press ENTER.

If the host reports a different port because
{0} was busy, join with   IP:PORT

On the same house network, use the host's
local IP and skip the port forwarding.
onlineHelp.p3.title: WHAT CHANGES
onlineHelp.p3.body:
Dying does not end the run. You drop out for
a few seconds, then respawn with half health.
The enemies turn on whoever is still standing,
so the run only ends if EVERYONE is down.

TIME STOP and the TOTEM are switched off
online - both rewrite the whole world, which
only works when one player owns it.

You will see everything your friend throws
out - bullets, arrows, slashes, the hook,
the thrown hammer and every SUPER.
